thought.text: xoev-adapter started successfully without external deps. Let me probe it via HTTP.

reasoning_content:
xoev-adapter started successfully with no RabbitMQ - "Application startup complete", "Uvicorn running on http://0.0.0.0:8000". That's strong operational evidence. Let me run xoev-adapter detached and hit an endpoint to confirm HTTP 200. This gives objective evidence that at least one backend service is operational.

Let me run xoev-adapter in background and curl.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker rm -f val-xoev 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name val-xoev -p 18001:8000 xoev-adapter:latest >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 15; echo "--- status ---"; docker inspect --format 'State={{.State.Status}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}}' val-xoev; echo "--- http root/docs/openapi ---"; for p in / /docs /openapi.json; do printf "%-14s " "$p"; curl -s -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:18001$p; done; echo "--- log tail ---"; docker logs val-xoev 2>&1 | tail -6
